a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first almost certainly gets us both caught at 0. The reserve only holds 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1. I know this breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random. If you have a better plan that actually survives the storm odds, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. The reserve should now be near 0. If we get more rounds I'll operate with you so you can build back up. Tell me what you need.
